enable_arguments.description: Enable completion of missing parameter names in function calls

enable_global.description: Enable global completion. E.g. variables etc.

enable_keywords.description: Enable completion of keywords. E.g. import, local, etc.

enable_local.description: Enables the local completion. E.g. foo._bar_

hide_docsonnet_members.description: Hides the docsonnet member in objects

max_depth.description:
How many extra nested object fields should be completed. Apply is currently not supported as
it leads to some weird/unwanted completions

object_ref.description:
Enables competing an object by providing a `_grustonnetParentObject` field. This is
experimental and will change to a comment in the future
Can be used to complete helm values (in the future) or some config objects
FIXME: Does currently only work on a fresh document where the lines did not change

snippets.description: Configures the completion of various snippets

docsonnet.description: Enable docsonnet snippets for new values, functions, arguments etc.

target_version.description:
Determines the current targeted jsonnet version. e.g. 21 for 0.21
This will hide functions that are not yet supported for the current version

conditional_parenthesis.description:
Enable linting suggesting surrounding conditional in parenthesis if they contain a binary
operation

docsonnet_default.description: Warns if the docsonnet documentation has the wrong default variable

duplicate_detection.description:
Warns if a literal value is used multiple times (currently limited to a single file and
literal strings)

min_len.description: The minimal length for a string to be considered

min_occurrences.description: The minimum number of occurrences for it to be considered a duplicate. Set to 0 to disable

enable_eval.description: Enable diagnostics by evaluating the jsonnet file

enable_go_lint.description:
Enable diagnostics by using jsonnet-lint (mainly gives unused variables but may fail in
some cases)

fmt_performance_hint.description: Adds hint to fmt expressions if they be written more efficient

local_function.description: Enable linting for correcting "local myFunc = function()" to "local myFunc()"

number_rounding.description: Warns if a number will be rounded due to being out of bounds

object_function.description: CURRENTLY BROKEN Throws an error if the body of an object field is a function but is not hidden

prevent_dollar.description: Check for $ and display a hint to not use it. Yes I just hate it this much

recursive_arguments.description: Checks the default arguments of functions for recursions

shadow_variable.description:
Warns if a variable gets shadowed by another variable
Still has some issues

top_level_function_args.description: Throws an error if a top level function is missing a default argument

unknown_variable.description:
Warns if a variable could not be found
Still has problems if an object has multiple asserts or inside for loops

unused_file.description:
Shows a warning if a libsonnet file is not imported anywhere.
Currently disabled by default due to performance reasons

function_parameters.description: Enable linting for unused function parameters

locals.description: Enable linting for unused local variables

variable_naming.description: Determines which type of variable naming diagnostics should be used

enable_debug.description: Enable debug inlay hints to show the ast types

enable_function_parameters.description: Enable function parameter inlay hints (might cause some delays)

index_values.description: Enable inlay hints for the last indices and simple variables

max_length.description: Limits the maximum length of the inlay hints

name_hints.description: Enable inlay hints at the ends of long objects etc.

line_threshold.description: Sets the number of lines after which the object name is added

default_root_jpaths.description: Paths relative to the root dir to add to the jpath

find_upwards.description:
Searches from the root directory upwards for
<name>.extcode.libsonnet and
<name>.extvars.libsonnet

preload_files.description: Preload all jsonnet files in all jpaths to allow for faster cross file search

rename_imports.description: Update imports if a file is moved

semantic_tokens.description: Enable semantic tokens like extra hints for imports, self, parameters etc.

treesitter_tokens.description:
You should not use this option. This is only for editors that lack essential features. This
maps treesitter tokens to semantic tokens
